heard: This colossal galaxy spans about 16 million light years across. Our Milky Way is just a speck in comparison. 100 Milky Way's laid end-to-end barely match it. Astronomers named this monster Alcionis after a Greek giant. A supermassive black hole shoots plasma jets out from its center. Scientists were shocked to find the host galaxy is actually totally average. This normal heart is what grew this colossal galaxy.
